annotation: One project author judgement, headline only. Score a multiset of (kind,status) per record. The seven baseline action families concern real-world news; explicit phone calls/interviews count as meetings. Unknown actors are allowed. Exclude fiction, market movements and generic recommendations without an action decision. Disjoint record IDs from the same archive next 10 candidate-cued and 10 uncued items. Counts explicit armed fighting/shooting as attack, explicit trade request as speech; heart attack and brand name Talk are outside scope. Two headlines report the same UN story; sample is not independent across stories.
